hint: Curated German word stems that must not appear as parts of an identifier in code (tools/check/identifiers.mjs). Lowercase a-z, umlauts transliterated (ae oe ue ss). words: a name part must EQUAL one of them; no word that is also English (rat rest art gift bad fast hat will man die sein also name last ...) goes there; checked against 25k files of English npm packages and the iOS SDK interfaces (the few hits there are other languages, not English). Short German function words (am als um nr ja der das ist nicht im je wo zu von bei fuer und oder ...) are words too: none of them is an English identifier part. stems: a part of >= 7 letters STARTS with one. exactOnly: counts only when it is the whole name (stand, war, mit: English inside a compound — standAlone, MIT_LICENSE — German only alone; hat stays out: `hat` alone is English too). notFirst: counts as the whole name or as any part AFTER the first (was: English leads with it — wasReady, wasOpen —, German stands it alone — { was } — or after a noun — gateWas). Left out on purpose because every use in this tree is English or letter data: an, da, ab, die, so, also, es, den, des, dem, ins, fest, hole, laden, grad, kern, mio.
